actions.reason: C0001 shows strong biological support: RNA pathway enrichment with large effect sizes and BAP1 mutation enrichment (OR=12.46, q=0.0029). No significant technical confounding per-set. Cross-modal consistency is weak but RNA is the primary driver, and the set has a defensible identity. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

C0002 shows strong biological support: RNA pathway enrichment and multiple significant CNV features. Cross-modal consistency is moderate with high resampling ARI (0.704) and low PAC (0.434). Although technical confounding is present (BP site, GE, LightSpeed16), it does not invalidate the biological distinctiveness. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

C0003 lacks significant biological support across all modalities (no RNA pathways, no mutations, no CNV features). Strong technical confounding (manufacturer, scanner, kernel) likely explains any apparent differences. Cross-modal consistency is driven mainly by CT, but the set is small and not biologically distinct. No supported non-terminal action or resolvable evidence gap remains.

C0004 shows moderate biological support: RNA pathway enrichment (7 pathways) and trends in CNV. No significant technical confounding per-set. Cross-modal consistency is weak but multiple modalities show positive silhouettes. The set has a defensible identity with no better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap.
